my_mean <- function(x) {
  total <- sum(x)
  n <- length(x)
  output <- total / n
  return(output)
}

my_var <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  mean_x <- my_mean(x)
  squared_distances <- (x - mean_x)^2
  total_squared_distance <- sum(squared_distances)

  output <- total_squared_distance / (n - 1)
  return(output)

  total <- sum(x)

  return(output)

my_var <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  mean_x <- my_mean(x)
  squared_distances <- (x - mean_x)^2
  total_squared_distance <- sum(squared_distances)

  output <- total_squared_distance / (n - 1)
  return(output)
}



# Spread and Standard Error ------------------------------------------------

  output <- sqrt(my_var(x))
  return(output)

  output <- sd_x / sqrt(n)
  return(output)

  )

my_null_t <- function(n, pop_mean, pop_sd) {
  sample_values <- rnorm(n = n, mean = pop_mean, sd = pop_sd)

my_cutoffs <- function(null_ts, alpha = 0.05) {
  sorted <- sort(null_ts)
  n <- length(sorted)
  k <- floor(n * alpha / 2)
  lower <- sorted[k + 1]
  upper <- sorted[n - k]
  output <- c(lower, upper)
  return(output)
}
